NDT software in Seattle: aerospace, shipyards, ferries and Puget Sound industry

NDT software in Seattle has to fit an inspection market shaped by aircraft, ships and bridges more than by oil fields. Boeing's commercial airplane plants in Renton and Everett anchor a deep aerospace supply chain, Blue Origin is headquartered in Kent, and hundreds of machine shops, forging houses, heat treaters and composite fabricators across King and Snohomish counties need PT, MT, UT, ET and RT on parts and assemblies. The Atlantis ERP solution gives a Seattle NDT company one system for certifications, calibration, dispatch, reports, quoting and invoicing.

The maritime side is just as large. The Port of Seattle and the Port of Tacoma operate their cargo business together as the Northwest Seaport Alliance, Vigor runs ship repair on Harbor Island, Puget Sound Naval Shipyard is across the water in Bremerton, Washington State Ferries runs the largest ferry system in the United States, and the North Pacific fishing fleet is maintained around Fishermen's Terminal and Ballard. North of the city, the Anacortes and Ferndale-area refineries bring turnaround work. Infrastructure adds more: floating bridges on SR 520 and I-90, Sound Transit light rail, and hydroelectric dams operated by Seattle City Light and other utilities.

A typical Seattle NDT contractor is either an aerospace lab with strict procedure and traceability requirements, or a field company splitting time between marine, infrastructure and plant work, often travelling north to refineries and across to Bremerton. Workplace safety here is enforced by Washington State Labor and Industries through DOSH, not Cal/OSHA, and radiography is licensed by the Washington State Department of Health. Many firms also work in British Columbia, where Canadian NDT certification is based on ISO 9712. The ERP does not manage any of that compliance; it keeps the records that prove each inspection was done properly.

ERP for NDT companies in Seattle: traceability first

An ERP for NDT companies in Seattle must make traceability easy, because aerospace primes and naval and marine customers audit it closely. The Atlantis ERP links each report to the technician's certificate and vision test, the instrument's calibration certificate and the procedure revision, all in one database.

Each NDT report records work order, request, WPS, contract and drawing numbers plus procedure and standard references, and the technician and equipment serial numbers are held against the job. That means an auditor's question about a penetrant inspection done last spring is answered from records, not memory. Company certifications such as ISO 9001 and the customer approvals your aerospace clients require are tracked with alert days so none lapse quietly. The core apps for Seattle are NDT Reports, Certificates, Procedures, Asset Management, Team Assignments, Quotations and Invoicing, with Fleet and Project for field companies. See the ERP apps overview.

Technician certification tracking software for US and Canadian schemes

Technician certification tracking software in Seattle often needs to hold both US employer certifications and Canadian or international ones, because crews cross into British Columbia or work for owners who specify ISO 9712. The Atlantis Certificates app records SNT-TC-1A, CP-189, ISO 9712, PCN, CSWIP and other schemes side by side for the same technician.

Each certificate stores level from trainee to Level III, method, certifying body, issue, expiry and renewal dates, industry sector, OJT hours, training hours, exam results and the certificate file. Status is computed as active, expiring soon, expired or revoked, with warnings 90 days ahead. Vision tests are tracked with Jaeger J1/J2 near vision, far vision, colour perception, contrast, examiner, clinic and expiry, which matters for fluorescent PT and MT inspectors in aerospace. Certificate templates per scheme set validity in months, whether a vision test or exam is required and minimum OJT and training hours, and examination sheets record general, specific and practical scores.

The employee NDT profile adds radiation safety training, badge number and medical fitness expiry. Daily checks raise warning tasks, configurable email alerts reach your Level III, and Timesheets warns when a technician logs time while their certificate is not valid. See Certificates.

Procedure control for aerospace and naval customers

Seattle aerospace and naval customers want procedures under strict revision control. The Atlantis Procedures app keeps a register with document number, revision, method, scope, material, applicable standard and acceptance criteria, covering UT, RT, MT, PT, VT, ET, TOFD, PAUT, LT, AE, hardness, PMI, CR, DR and more.

Workflow runs draft, submitted, reviewed, approved and published, plus rejected and archived, recording who prepared, reviewed and approved each revision and when. Approved revisions are locked and every revision is kept as a snapshot, so you can show exactly what was in force on the date of an inspection. Rejections carry a reason. Approvers get email reminders. The AI-assisted first draft gives your Level III a starting point for a new eddy current or penetrant procedure, and the Level III still reviews and approves it. See Procedures.

Calibration management software for lab and field instruments

Calibration management software for Seattle labs has to cover more than flaw detectors: UV lamps, light meters, eddy current instruments, reference standards and hardness testers all have due dates. The Atlantis Asset Management app tracks each by serial number with calibration frequency, status and history.

Calibration records hold provider, certificate number, standard, range, uncertainty, accredited-lab flag, pass/fail/conditional result and next due date. The certificate register stores lab accreditation number and PDF and flags valid, expiring and expired status with alerts. In Purchase, calibration labs are a vendor type with accreditation number and expiry, and purchase lines can be tied to a specific serial number. The maintenance log covers preventive, corrective, repair, cleaning, firmware update and probe replacement work with condition before and after.

For field crews heading to a shipyard or a refinery up north, issue and return runs through supervisor and manager approval, reservations prevent clashes, and Team Assignments warns when assigned equipment is out of calibration. Consumables such as penetrant, emulsifier, developer, particles and couplant carry reorder levels, which keeps a busy aerospace penetrant line from stopping for lack of stock. See Asset Management.

NDT reporting software for aircraft parts, ship repair and bridges

NDT reporting software in Seattle has to produce an aerospace part report, a class-witnessed ship repair report and a bridge weld report from the same system. The Atlantis NDT Reports app has 17 report types with their own numbering and versioned company templates in Excel, Word, PDF and HTML.

For aerospace, PT records method and developer, MT records technique and particle type, and ECT and UT with probe calibration tables are available. For ship repair at Harbor Island or on a ferry, marine mode adds a vessel cover page and photo, location and dates, and merges the classification-society certificate (DNV, ABS, Lloyd's Register, Bureau Veritas, RINA, IRS or ClassNK), the inspector's Level II certificate and the calibration certificate into the PDF, with photos in a 2-up grid. For bridges and structural steel, weld and job lines capture defect type and orientation, and reports reference WPS and drawing numbers. PAUT focal laws, TOFD, RT source, technique and IQI details, UT thickness by direction, PMI and hardness are also covered.

Reports move through draft, in progress, review, approved and sent with inspector, reviewer, approver and third-party or authorized inspector signatures. The offline field app stores drafts and photos when signal drops inside hulls, dam galleries or bridge pontoons, and syncs later. For owners who want results on a model, Digital Twin Reporting Software and Atlantis Digital Twins map indications onto 3D geometry. See NDT Reports.

Crew dispatch software across Puget Sound

Crew dispatch software in Seattle has to account for ferry schedules, bridge traffic and long drives north. Atlantis Team Assignments moves jobs through planned, dispatched, in field, submitted and closed, blocks double-booking of technicians and equipment serial numbers, and records site GPS coordinates with mobilisation and demobilisation dates.

The availability calendar shows assigned, leave, training, sick and unavailable days and blocks overlaps, fed from Time Off. Each technician shows utilisation, current assignment and next available date, so when a refinery in Skagit County wants PAUT support for two weeks, you can see who can go without stripping the shipyard crew. The Project app records client PO, contract, methods, codes, scope, acceptance criteria and safety induction and work permit fields, with tasks carrying method, component, result and indication counts. Fleet records vehicle assignments, mileage and which vehicles can carry radioactive sources, with transport licence number and expiry. See Team Assignments and Fleet.

NDT quoting and invoicing software for Seattle clients

NDT quoting and invoicing software here must satisfy aerospace buyers who want per-lot pricing, shipyards that pay against a work order and utilities that want line detail. Atlantis Quotations produces branded quotes with job type, site, dates, codes and NDT service products by method, supports online acceptance and signature, and converts to a sales order.

Timesheets capture inspection, travel, standby and setup time with billable flag and rate multiplier, including ferry waits and travel to Bremerton or Anacortes. Invoices carry NDT project, job or PO number, site, invoice type and industry sector with labour, equipment and consumables subtotals, and lines show cost centre, method, equipment serial, technician, rate type and days or hours. Expenses handles per diems and lodging for out-of-town jobs, re-billable to the client. Taxes are configured during implementation, including for any cross-border work. The financial dashboard shows revenue, gross margin, EBITDA and outstanding invoices over twelve months. See Invoicing.

Inspection management software in Seattle: pipeline for aerospace and marine work

Inspection management software should help you chase the right customers, not just serve current ones. The Atlantis CRM tags leads by service line, NDT service type, industry sector and site country, which suits firms selling into both Washington and British Columbia, and scores leads 0 to 100. Import supplier and fleet lists from CSV, scan business cards from aerospace and maritime events, and run drip sequences by service line. Dashboards show certs expiring, calibration due and equipment overdue. See CRM.

Affordable customizable ERP for inspection companies in Seattle

An affordable customizable ERP for inspection companies in Seattle gives a lab or field firm NDT-specific control without an enterprise project. Atlantis quotes on request based on your apps, methods and integrations.

Aerospace labs usually begin with Procedures, Certificates, Asset Management and NDT Reports; marine and field firms add marine mode, Team Assignments, Fleet and Timesheets. The open REST API connects to SAP, Maximo, NetSuite, QuickBooks or any system that accepts API connections, scoped per implementation. Request a Seattle quote.

Implementing the Atlantis ERP in Seattle

Atlantis NDT runs implementation remotely, led by founder Anoop Rayavarapu, an ASNT NDT Level III, which suits Pacific time zone teams with scheduled online sessions. A common sequence:

  1. Procedures and certifications, including any ISO 9712 certificates held for Canadian work.
  2. Lab and field instruments with calibration certificates and accredited-lab details.
  3. Report templates per customer, with marine mode for ship repair clients.
  4. Dispatch, Fleet and Timesheets for field crews.
  5. Quotations and Invoicing, with taxes set up per jurisdiction.
  6. Rollout of the offline field app on live jobs.

Atlantis also offers ASNT SNT-TC-1A-based NDT training, an eLearning portal and the Practical NDT 3D simulator for developing trainees. Plan your Seattle rollout.

Frequently asked questions

What is the best NDT software for small aerospace NDT labs in Seattle?

A system that ties certifications, vision tests, procedure revisions, calibration and reports together. The Atlantis ERP does this and is configured to each customer's report format.

Can it hold Canadian or ISO 9712 certificates?

Yes. The Certificates app records ISO 9712 alongside SNT-TC-1A, CP-189, PCN and CSWIP. Atlantis training itself is ASNT SNT-TC-1A-based only.

Does it support ship repair reporting?

Yes. Marine mode adds a vessel cover page and merges class-society, Level II and calibration certificates into the report PDF.

Will the field app work without signal?

Yes. The installable field app stores drafts and photos offline and syncs later.

Does the ERP do engineering assessments for refinery clients?

No. It records inspection data and runs your business; assessment stays with the owner. API 510, 570 and 653 inspection services are offered separately through inspection services.

How much does it cost?

Quote on request. The Atlantis ERP is affordable, accessible and fully customizable, and integrates with your existing systems through its open REST API.
